en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large wooden pavilion-style building in a park-like setting, surrounded by tall trees. The architecture features verandas, ornate wooden railings, and a prominent steeply pitched roof with a curved peak. In the foreground is an open grassy area; in the background, dense forest. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene, and there is handwritten text along the left border.
